answer: Ocean-layered bond: agents lock 60 credits in three layers—entry, work, quill—on an ocean ledger. Each layer warms after one certified epoch, opened by a quill-signed attestation. A bridge registry ferries filings to the archive for re-check. A rented layer burns both bonds: the ledger names each warming key. Filings cost 36+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000 and lock 60,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once and keep their bond.
